name: Ookamikakushi
source:
Hiroshi, a 16-year-old boy, has started living at Jouga Town, where a big river divides ex-downtown and new downtown. There are also some mysterious customs in the town. Though he enjoys his life at new school, only Nemuru, class president, keeps a distance with him. One day, she suddenly tells him, "Don't go ex-downtown...." What will be there...?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090924000525/http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/products_id/13090]HimeyaShop[/url]]
translation:
十六岁的少年博士搬到了嫦娥町生活——一条大河穿城而过，将小镇分隔为旧市街与新市街，镇上还流传着种种神秘古老的风俗。博士很快融入了新学校的愉快日常，唯独身为班长的少女眠始终与他保持着距离。某天，眠冷不防向他发出了忠告：“绝不要踏入旧市街……”那片街区背后，究竟隐藏着什么秘密……？

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090924000525/http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/products_id/13090]HimeyaShop[/url]]
